## Summary
<!-- What does this PR change, and which issue does it close? (e.g. Closes #123). For an issue labeled "multiple PRs", which is done in several PRs, write "Part of #123": "Closes" would close it when this PR is merged, and a check fails. -->

## How I checked it works
<!-- Required. Tests you ran, and what you looked at. A check fails while this is empty. -->

## Images
<!-- Required for any new or changed code under src/ (new algorithms, new components, bug fixes and refactoring): a check fails without them. Paste images or GIFs here (drag and drop) so the reviewer can see the result without running the code:
- New simulation or algorithm: its demo GIF
- New component used by a simulation: the GIF or last frame of that simulation
- Change to existing code (bug fix, improvement, refactoring): the last frame of one or two simulations that use it, before and after your change (for a refactoring, they should look the same)
- Book text: a screenshot of the changed part of the built page (optional)
- Docs, comments or tests only: not needed. If a change under src/ really has nothing to show (for example a docstring only), say why here, and the maintainer adds the "no images needed" label -->

## Book
<!-- The book (doc/) explains much of the code. If this PR changes code that a book page describes, update that page here too: text, equations, figures and literalinclude names. -->
- [ ] This PR doesn't change code that the book describes, or I updated those pages
